data.name: Mattias
data.gender_notes: Mattias is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name Mattityahu, meaning 'gift of God'. In the Bible, Mattias is mentioned as one of the twelve apostles, chosen by Jesus to spread his teachings. The name Mattias carries the meaning “Gift of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Mattias usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name reflecting the gift of life from God and the spiritual journey of the individual.
data.etymology: Mattias belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mattias total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_greek.name: Ματθίας
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ματθίας προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις 'δώρο' και 'Θεός', που σημαίνει δωρο του Θεού. Ο Ματθίας αναφέρεται και στη Καινή Διαθήκη ως ο απόστολος που εξελέγη στη θέση του Ιούδα Ισκαριώτη.

in_latin.name: Mattias
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Mattias derivatur ex hebraeo 'Mattityahu', quod significat 'donum Dei'. Mattias fuit apostolus Christi, electus ad supplendum locum Iudae Iscariotae.

in_english.name: Mattias
in_english.long_meaning: The name Mattias originates from the Hebrew 'Mattityahu', meaning 'gift of God'. In the New Testament, Mattias was the apostle chosen to replace Judas Iscariot. The name symbolizes divine favor and providence, reflecting spiritual significance in Christian tradition.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mattias holds significant cultural influence in the Christian world, as it is the given name of one of the twelve apostles of Jesus Christ. Mattias, or in its variant forms Matthias or Matthew, has been a popular given name in Europe for centuries. In many cultures, the name is associated with unwavering faith, discipleship, and loyalty due to Mattias's chosen role in the biblical narrative.
data.spiritual_significance: For those bearing the name Mattias, it holds profound spiritual meaning, representing the gift of being chosen by God to fulfill a specific purpose in spreading His teachings. This serves as a constant reminder of the importance of being faithful and dedicated to one's beliefs and values, which can inspire a sense of purpose, devotion and connection to the higher being.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Mattias, meaning "gift of God" in Hebrew, symbolizes the belief that every human being is a divine gift and a reflection of God's love and creativity. This name also encourages the recipient to strive towards living a life worthy of the gift bestowed upon them.

biblical_reference.note: Mattias was chosen as an apostle to replace Judas Iscariot.
